text: あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか　◎ノーマル　こおり　いわ　あく　はがね　△どく　ひこう　エスパー　むし　×ゴースト

structure.jp: あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか
◎ノーマル　こおり　いわ　あく　はがね
structure.en: super effective: Normal, Ice, Rock, Dark, Steel

structure.jp: △どく　ひこう　エスパー　むし
structure.en: not very effective: Poison, Flying, Psychic, Bug

patterns.name: 〜への
patterns.explanation: へ means 'toward', and の ties that to the next thing, so it is an effect aimed at something. あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか = 'the effect on the opposing Pokémon'.
